A '''hamlet''' was the home of [[Ves Volette]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] at some point during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Volette saw the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] at his hamlet during a [[memnis]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The hamlet was located in [[Jualya Village]] in [[Kanupian]].
